# Contributing to AI-Resume-Analyzer

This repository is an academic project by Shubham Kumar at RGIPT.

## Local setup

```bash
python -m venv venv
pip install -r requirements.txt
streamlit run app.py
```

Keep API keys in `utils/.env` and never commit secrets, databases containing personal data, or uploaded resumes.

## Changes

- Keep changes focused and explain the reason for each change.
- Update the README when setup or behaviour changes.
- Test the affected workflow locally before committing.
- Preserve the attribution and license requirements in `LICENSE` and `CREDITS.md`.
